description.value: The Tackle Box Coffee Bar is a specialty coffee bar nestled inside Rustic Reel Brewing Company in Kelowna, offering espresso drinks, teas, hot chocolate, and seasonal specialties alongside locally-sourced pastries and grab-and-go sandwiches. The space features a modern-rustic design with a cozy fireplace, nook seating, and a Community Room suited for meetings or work sessions. It draws both locals and visitors as a morning stop before an afternoon at the brewery taproom.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at rusticreel.com/pages/coffee confirms the Tackle Box Coffee Bar is an active, operating coffee bar located inside Rustic Reel Brewing Company at 760 Vaughan Ave, Kelowna. The phone number 250.862.3737 on the website matches the OSM value +1 250 862 3737. Takeout/online ordering is confirmed by the 'ORDER AHEAD' feature and 'grab-and-go sandwiches'; Wi-Fi is confirmed by the events page noting 'all day wifi' and the coffee bar page describing the space as suitable for 'quiet work sessions'; vegetarian/vegan/GF options are confirmed by the food menu listing falafel wraps, black bean quesadilla, vegan nachos, and GF bun substitutions.
concerns: OSM address field is empty; address 760 Vaughan Ave, Kelowna, BC V1Y 7E4 was taken from the website footer.
The Tackle Box Coffee Bar is a sub-brand operating inside Rustic Reel Brewing Company; the OSM record names only the coffee bar, not the parent brewery, which may cause confusion for visitors.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active coffee bar operating inside a brewery in Kelowna with a confirmed address, phone, and current website content. Useful morning stop for touring cyclists.
